title.zh: 两栖动物来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Amphibia to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开两栖动物，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Amphibia time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的两栖类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare gerobatrachus and triadobatrachus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较gerobatrachus与triadobatrachus；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the Kungurian Gerobatrachus window to inspect the Clear Fork Group occurrence linked to the single holotype and its source-bound range claim.
description.zh: 打开 Gerobatrachus 的贡古尔期窗口，检查与单件正模及其来源限定范围声明相连的克利尔福克组出现记录。

limitations: This Kungurian interval is the USNM 489135 specimen sample in the Clear Fork Group, not a global batrachian or lissamphibian FAD/LAD; the original stem-batrachian placement remains analysis-dependent.

description.en: Open the Early Triassic Triadobatrachus window to inspect the Betsiaka occurrence context associated with the split-nodule holotype and its range claim.
description.zh: 打开 Triadobatrachus 的早三叠世窗口，检查与裂结核正模及其范围声明相连的贝齐亚卡出现背景。

limitations: This route is bounded to the MNHN.F.MAE.126 part-and-counterpart sample and its broad stage-scale correlation; it is not a crown-Anura range, a direct ancestor or evidence of specialized jumping.

description.en: Open the Norian Funcusvermis window to inspect the U–Pb-bracketed Chinle Formation bonebed context linked to this total-group range claim.
description.zh: 打开 Funcusvermis 的诺利期窗口，检查与该总群范围声明相连、由 U–Pb 年龄限定的钦利组骨床背景。

limitations: The window represents isolated elements from at least seventy-six individuals in one Norian bonebed. It does not form an articulated individual, date crown Gymnophiona or establish a global caecilian range.

title.zh: Beiyanerpeton 蝾螈总科样本窗口

description.en: Open the Oxfordian Beiyanerpeton window to inspect the Tiaojishan Formation sample and the source-bound range claim for its six articulated specimens.
description.zh: 打开 Beiyanerpeton 的牛津期窗口，检查髫髻山组样本及其六件关节相连标本的来源限定范围声明。

limitations: The 160–154 Ma window is formation context for the six named specimens. Its cited 157 ± 3 Ma zircon age is from overlying rock, not direct dating of each skeleton or a global salamandroid range.

description.en: Open the Oligocene Ymboirana window to inspect the Tremembé Formation context for holotype DGM 1462-R and its provisional range claim.
description.zh: 打开 Ymboirana 的渐新世窗口，检查正模 DGM 1462-R 的特伦贝组背景及其暂定范围声明。

limitations: This is the single DGM 1462-R occurrence in the Tremembé Formation. The Typhlonectidae assignment is comparative and provisional, without an unambiguous family synapomorphy or formal phylogenetic test; the card is not a global crown-Gymnophiona age or distribution.
